headline: SITCON 2 (SEVERE): Chrome zero-day CVE-2026-125350 exploited; OpenSSH SSHole attacks continue; France ties Iran to refrigeration sabotage

bullets.text: Changed: a further report confirms Google patched the eighth Chrome zero-day exploited in attacks this year (CVE-2026-125350), bringing critical reports to 4 in 48 hours. SITCON holds at 2 (SEVERE), also on 4 CISA KEV additions in 72 hours.

Changed: the Iran story now spans 4 outlets. France blames Iran for a sabotage attack on refrigeration controllers at about 700 retail sites; earlier reports cover freezers in grocery stores and blood banks and attacks that sparked fires.

SSHole (OpenSSH CVE-2026-123158, an authentication bypass) is still being used to breach Linux systems, covered by 6 outlets. In CISA KEV since 11-09 alongside GPUStack CVE-2026-102895, FreeSwitch CVE-2026-116779 and IBM Aspera Faspex CVE-2026-123218; all four are due 11-12.
N-able took its hosted N-central cloud offline after a researcher disclosed 33 zero-days with proof-of-concept exploits. No fixes are named in the reporting yet.

Cloud trust abuse continues: Fireworks AI disclosed a new breach after a hack of its cloud provider, attackers used Qubole's trusted AWS access to breach customer accounts, and a separate report describes backdoored AWS integrations stealing secrets.

Still developing: Ethersphere's bee-js and Swarm Desktop compromised to deliver wallet-stealing malware; 300 malicious packages listed in the GitHub Advisory Database in 7 days, mostly npm; Vanderbilt ransomware and the Beget wiper attack. The last 7 days ran 0.85x the 90-day average.

actions: Update Chrome on all endpoints to the latest release (fixes CVE-2026-125350) and restart browsers; confirm managed fleets picked it up.
Patch OpenSSH for CVE-2026-123158 on every internet-facing host; restrict SSH exposure and review auth logs for unexpected logins.
Patch or isolate GPUStack (CVE-2026-102895), FreeSwitch (CVE-2026-116779) and IBM Aspera Faspex (CVE-2026-123218) before the 11-12 KEV deadline.
N-central users: plan for the hosted outage, limit network exposure of N-central servers and agents, and watch N-able for fixes.
Audit IAM roles that trust third-party AWS accounts; remove unused integrations such as Qubole and rotate secrets they could reach.
Confirm refrigeration and building-control controllers are not reachable from the internet; VMware ESX CVE-2026-41709 is due in KEV 11-11.
